newsitem.title: USA: Tele-TV chair may join Sony America -report.
newsitem.headline: Tele-TV chair may join Sony America -report.

text.p: Tele-TV Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Howard Stringer is in serious talks to receive a senior position at Sony Corp of America, Daily Variety said on Friday, citing sources.
Tele-TV is a programming venture set up by Bell Atlantic, NYNEX and Pacific Telesis. Stringer was expected to leave his post there on Friday, it said.
Stringer was said to have been in serious negotiations with Sony Corp president Nobuyuki Idei for the last several months about joining the company but there was no firm deal yet, the report said.
